name: hud_ui_background_cursor_set_capture_enabled
description: HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::SetCaptureEnabled stores the capture flag, destroys and clears captured image state when disabling capture, clears the widget blit source, and rebuilds captured image state when enabling with no existing capture.
known_limits: The smoke covers the disable branch with an owned captured image. The enable/rebuild branch is accepted compositionally from SetImageBorrowedAndRefresh functional evidence.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudUiBackground cursor-widget pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4bfa90 validates capture flag storage, disable-and-captured-image branch through zVid_Image::Destroy, capturedImage clear, ftable slot 6 SetBltSourceAndClipRect(null, null), and rebuild dispatch when capturedImage is null.
The native smoke verifies disabling capture destroys/clears the captured image and clears the widget blit source.
